commonScope: Every tracked leaf outside the six package roots, and all package membership, path kinds, modes, manifests, instructions, profiles, toolchain and runner helpers. Only existing regular src/tests code body changes qualify. All six product packages, root, typed, native, Darwin and PostgreSQL remain required.
ciSelftestInputs: Contracts and their registered regressions execute synthetic product bodies. Actual CI helpers/tests, ER runner/reporter anchors, workflows, policy, installation and toolchain are common inputs; the complete B/H membership/kind/mode census must be unchanged. Body copies/hashes in classifier fixtures do not interpret product code. The independent bootstrap admits the exact published optimizer source census and closed control import graph before candidate import; candidate policy or declarations cannot authorize their own admission. Installation admission uses a bounded no-execution parse of the real pnpm 11.18.0 JSON .modules.yaml metadata and requires exact packageManager and virtualStoreDir values. Nominal identity keys reject escaped spellings, duplicate keys and nested aliases before JSON policy evaluation. Only the whole unchanged CI regression may defer; node scripts/ci/conformance.ts always executes on current source in PR quick routing.
environment: Same-repository ordinary pull_request in the CI caller only; github-hosted ubuntu-24.04/X64/glibc 2.39, Node 24.21.0, pnpm 11.18.0. Fresh frozen normal installation with store integrity verification before any repository helper; virtual-store-only metadata is not an operational installation and selects FULL. Current installed files, link targets, executable modes and native bytes bound before/after. The exact package source anchor is checked before dynamic import, while frozen-store observation is not source authority. No loader/native/test-selection or CI test-baseline/observation overrides. Uncertainty selects FULL. GitHub Free workflow bytes are bounded by the event/caller contract but are not an independent external trust root.
sampling: A deferral executes zero test identities and claims no pass at H. It needs no historical receipt or authenticated old PASS. Residual runner regressions are sampled by complete main/night/merge/reusable CI. First policy/common/bootstrap change, optimizer admission failure, or uncertain tuple executes the existing FULL command independently; failure of FULL remains a hard failure.
